text: Victor and Nikki Newman are fictional characters and a supercouple from the American CBS soap opera The Young and the Restless. Victor is portrayed by Eric Braeden and Nikki by Melody Thomas Scott. The couple has shared three marriages and two children: Victoria and Nicholas Newman (Amelia Heinle and Joshua Morrow). They are often referred to by fans as "Niktor" on internet message boards and in magazines. Nikki was originally from the lower walks of life, having been a stripper and prostitute. After multiple failed relationships, she began a romance with Victor, who taught her about society. They fell in love and had a daughter, Victoria Newman (Heather Tom), and later a son, Nicholas Newman (Joshua Morrow). Their pairing was originally written to follow a continuous cycle of marriage and divorce, a take on the original supercouple formula, which has persisted throughout their time on the show and is regarded as an "inspired decision," leading to them becoming the most successful supercouple on The Young and the Restless. The couple's first wedding took place on the episode that aired on April 13, 1984. Nikki gave birth to Victoria in 1982, and the pair married in 1984. Ashley Abbott (Eileen Davidson, Brenda Epperson) came between them, causing their divorce, after which both remarried—Victor to Ashley and Nikki to Jack Abbott (Peter Bergman). However, they remained linked, with an affair resulting in the birth of Nicholas. Despite Victor marrying architect Diane Jenkins (Alex Donnelley) in 1997, Nikki suffered a gunshot wound the following year and came close to death, leading Victor to supposedly divorce Diane and remarry Nikki on her deathbed. However, Victor and Diane's divorce was never legal, invalidating their remarriage. An actual divorce between Victor and Diane occurred, resulting in their reunion. In September 2002, they remarried again at the site of their first wedding, a union that lasted six years. In 2008, Nikki began an affair with David Chow (Vincent Irizarry), leading to their second divorce. Melody Thomas Scott has stated that the couple always has to get back together, but "not without a challenge," and that the writers must create believable storylines because people care about them. In March 2013, after four years of an on-and-off relationship, Victor and Nikki remarried for the third time, coinciding with the 40th anniversary of The Young and the Restless. Victor and Nikki are recognized as one of daytime television's most prominent pairings and have received positive reviews from critics. The News & Advance cited their romance as part of the "epic" romances of the early supercouple era. The couple has a large fan following and their weddings have been reported by mainstream media. Scott has said that Victor and Nikki will always be a huge dynamic, having been in a circular cycle for over 30 years. Braeden has stated that the storyline is an "honestly felt love story with great material for conflict with Nikki." Former As the World Turns actress Martha Byrne has said that Victor and Nikki exemplify a couple who are repeatedly torn apart and reunited, and that the writers do it well because the characters are stable. Daytime expert Michael Fairman stated that Victor and Nikki just can't get together long enough to find happiness, and that they "deserve" each other and the baggage that comes with their co-dependent relationship.
